I have a brother, Eoin Byrne, born on 2 February 1978, and a half-sister, Aoife Byrne, from my dad's first marriage to Gráinne Doyle.

Our youngest, Oisín, was born on 5 November 2020.

I inherited my late dad's cottage in Dingle in 2015. I bought a flat in Cork on 3 May 2018 for 240,000 EUR. Eoin and I co-own a field in Kinsale.
I bought a sailing boat called the Kittiwake in 2014 and sold it to Cian Murphy on 1 July 2021.
